messages.en:
{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Today's every
kid's dream, the big
{ff 00 00 03}Bug-Off{ff 00 00 00}!
So you think you've got a
shot at winning? You'd
better stop dreamin'!
{07 15 00}At the end of the day,
only one of us walks away
with that trophy.
So stay outta my way!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Täna on iga
lapse unistus, suur
{ff 00 00 03}putukavõistlus{ff 00 00 00}!
Nii et sa arvad, et sul on
võiduvõimalus? Sa parem
lõpeta unistamine!
{07 15 00}Päeva lõpus kõnnib ainult
üks meist selle karikaga
minema.
Nii et hoia eemale!

messages.en:
{07 12 00}Nnnngh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Yeah, so it's the
big {ff 00 00 03}Bug-Off{ff 00 00 00} and all, {07 00 00}but I

{07 14 00}I just wanna hang out{01 00 00 03 00}

{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 12 00}Nnnngh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Jah, on siis
suur {ff 00 00 03}putukavõistlus{ff 00 00 00}, {07 00 00}aga

{07 14 00}Ma tahan lihtsalt olla{01 00 00 03 00}
ja maastikku nautida,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Today's the big {04 03 00}
{ff 00 00 03}Bug-Off{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0b 00}Huh?{01 00 00 0f 00} What makes it so big?
{07 15 00}Look, we're in a small town
here, kid! You wanna give
us a break, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Täna on suur {04 03 00}
{ff 00 00 03}putukavõistlus{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0b 00}Ah?{01 00 00 0f 00} Mis teeb selle suureks?
{07 15 00}Kuule, me oleme väikeses
linnas, laps! Ole nüüd
natuke lebe, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Whaa?! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!!!{01 00 00 14 00}


You think that just 'cause
I'm in the lead right now,
{07 0b 00}I'm heading for a fall?
{07 15 00}I don't like your attitude,
kid!

{07 00 00}This {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm
{ff 00 00 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} is
my ticket to victory!{01 00 00 05 00}
I've got this for sure,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Miiis?! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!!!{01 00 00 14 00}


Sa arvad, et kuna ma olen
praegu juhtpositsioonil,
{07 0b 00}siis ma kukun?
{07 15 00}Mulle ei meeldi su hoiak,
laps!

{07 00 00}See {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm
{ff 00 00 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} on
mu pilet võidule!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ma olen selle kindlasti
võitnud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}There isn't anything sad
about chasin' bugs at our
age!
{07 1c 00}The only sad thing would be
getting too old to run
after 'em, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}But, hey,{01 00 00 05 00} I've got plenty of
good bug-chasin' years still
left in me!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Meie vanuses pole putukate
taga ajamises midagi
kurba!
{07 1c 00}Ainus kurb asi oleks
liiga vanaks jääda, et
joosta, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Aga, kuule,{01 00 00 05 00} mul on veel
palju häid putukajahi
aastaid ees!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You can't rely on your eyes
alone to hunt bugs, y'know.

{07 15 00}You gotta FEEL the bug{07 00 00}
{ff 00 00 02}before you swing your net{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Putukajahil ei saa loota
ainult silmadele, tead.

{07 15 00}Sa pead putukat TUNDMA{07 00 00}
{ff 00 00 02}enne, kui võrku vehid{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Bugs are really different
from folks like us,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1c 00}Even if they were our size,
I don't think we'd get
along.
{07 15 00}Y'know, they'd be trying to
conquer us and become
our insect overlords.
And that is just NOT cool!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Putukad on meiesugustest
tõesti erinevad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1c 00}Isegi kui nad oleks meie
suurused, ma ei arva, et
me läbi saaksime.
{07 15 00}Tead, nad üritaksid meid
vallutada ja saada meie
putukvalitsejateks.
Ja see pole üldse lahe!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{0b 03 00}{04 10 00} is a better
bug hunter than I thought!

{07 1b 00}Oh, but you already
knew that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{0b 03 00}{04 10 00} on parem
putukajahtija kui arvasin!

{07 1b 00}Oh, aga sa juba
teadsid seda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}Sellise tempoga võidab
{04 10 00} kõik,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Aga mind ei huvita mingi
vana {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm
{ff 00 00 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!
See pole veel läbi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I thought bugs were hard to
find, but I took a nap at
a friend's house.
{07 07 00}When I woke up, there were
bugs all over the place!
Did that really happen?!
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Or am I going crazy?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma arvasin, et putukaid on
raske leida, aga ma tegin
sõbra majas uinaku.
{07 07 00}Kui ma ärkasin, oli
putukaid igal pool!
Kas see juhtus tõesti?!
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Või lähen ma hulluks?
